payload.question: On 2026-10-24 you decided "An out-of-date plumb shows red in the band". The update check now does more: it compares the running plumb with your local main and with the online repository, tells you to push main or to update depending on which is behind, and shows a plain "could not check" line when the repository can't be read. Does your decision cover that?
